gameOver.title: Game Over
gameOver.descriptionEndGame: You have reached the end of your adventure. Record your glory to compare it with your friends. You can then start a new game to improve your performance, or continue with a campaign expansion to face new challenges while keeping part of your current kingdom.
gameOver.descriptionExpansion: Once you finish the base game, you may play up to 10 different expansions, one at a time. Expansions are new chapters of your kingdom story, providing more rounds of play. They often introduce new cards and concepts that you may continue to develop even after the expansion is over. Each kingdom may only play each expansion once.

campaign.chooseExpansionDescription: Save your score for this segment, choose one expansion, then complete the purge before the next round.
campaign.purgeDescription: For each batch of 12 cards, choose 1 allied card to purge. Then purge allied permanents if required.
campaign.purgeBatchLabel: Choose one allied card from the current batch
campaign.purgePermanentLabel: Choose one allied permanent card to purge

Prosperity.title: Prosperity
Prosperity.description: This mini expansion introduces permanent card #136 (Prosperity). It guiding you through 4 additional game rounds. You will perform a purge 12 and purge 1 permanent card. In these expansions, you do NOT discover 2 new cards at the start of the round. When done, add the score of this segment to your previous score, then choose the next expansion.

tutorial.welcome: Welcome to Deck Legacy! Your deck is your new kingdom: develop it to become the greatest of lords.
tutorial.goal: The goal of the game is to develop your kingdom by upgrading your deck of cards, and to gather as much Glory {{glory}} as possible over several campaigns.

startingDeck.cards: Each player starts with the same deck of 10 cards, numbered 1 to 10.
startingDeck.future: These cards will upgrade over the game, and many new cards will join them: your kingdom will grow vaster and more prosperous, but also more dangerous.

interface.draw: Your draw pile: this is where you will find the cards you play this round.
interface.discard: Your discard pile: this is where your cards go once they are used.
interface.resourceBar: Here you follow the current round and turn, the resources you have and your Glory {{glory}}.

card.overview: Let's take a card as an example and look at it closely: the Forest.
card.number: Each card has a unique number that identifies it.
card.name: Each card has a name that defines its current state.
card.tags: Each card has one or more types. Some effects only concern cards of a given type.
card.production: Some cards have a production: by discarding the card, you gain these resources. The Forest produces 1 {{wood}}.
card.action: {{action}} Some cards have actions: by discarding the card, you apply its effect. This one is free: you gain 3 {{wood}}, then the Forest becomes a Felled Forest.
card.actionCost: Some actions have a cost to pay. The Trader, for example, trades 1 {{gold}} for 1 {{wood}}.
card.otherEffects: You will come across other effect icons: {{time}} discard the card and end the turn, {{passif}} always active, {{destroy}} destroy the card, {{trigger}} triggered automatically. The rules detail them all.
card.upgrade: Some cards can be upgraded: by paying this cost, the card moves to a different state. With 2 {{stone}}, the Forest becomes a Sacred Well.
card.statePreview: Tap here to discover all the states the card can take.

turn1.hand: Turn 1: each turn starts by drawing 4 cards from your deck.
turn1.objective: Your goal this turn: upgrade the Distant Mountain into a Rocky Area. It costs 2 {{gold}}.
turn1.produce: Produce with this Wild Grass to gain 1 {{gold}}. The card is discarded. ⚠️ Produced resources are lost as soon as another card is drawn.
turn1.produceAgain: Produce with the second Wild Grass: you now have 2 {{gold}}.
turn1.upgrade: Upgrade the Distant Mountain. An upgrade always ends the turn.
turn1.next: The turn is over, the other cards are discarded. Start the next turn.

turn2.notEnough: Same goal with the second Distant Mountain. But only one Wild Grass is in play: 1 {{gold}}, not enough.
turn2.progress: Progress: draw 2 more cards. Always draw before producing, or you lose your resources.
turn2.produce: Two new {{gold}} producers! Produce with the Wild Grass…
turn2.endRound: Your draw pile is empty: the round ends. All your cards are shuffled for the next one.

tutorial.discovery: Each new round, 2 new cards from the discovery pile join your deck.
tutorial.end: You have played your first round! Keep playing this game, or start a new one from scratch? You can reread the rules at any time.
